name: @jewelry-platform/cordova-app
description: Cordova wrapper for Bizmation web app

scripts.plugin:add: cordova plugin add cordova-plugin-whitelist cordova-plugin-inappbrowser cordova-plugin-network-information
scripts.build:android: npm run prepare ; cordova build android
scripts.build:ios: npm run prepare ; cordova build ios
scripts.run:android: npm run prepare ; cordova run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run prepare ; cordova run ios
